verdict.rationale: PII detection and redaction is a fair capability to ask of a scraping and extraction service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic detection or filtering of personally identifiable information in scraped content. The nearby controls (API-key format restrictions, risky-URL blocking, audit event streaming, schema-based JSON extraction) are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
